title: OpenDEA Assessment Insight
description: A governed, evidence-bound interpretation derived across assessment evidence (CR-AM-08 §3). An AssessmentInsight answers 'what does the evidence tell us?' over AssessmentResults, AssessmentViews, and BenchmarkComparisons. It is an interpretation, never a fact: the cited evidence remains authoritative, and an insight must never assert more than its evidence supports (CR-AM-08 §3, §6). Insight is distinct from Finding (an observation on one result, CR-AM-04) and prescribes no actions (CR-AM-08 §9 — the TRANSFORM stage stays outside the assessment metamodel). This schema defines the insight shape only — InsightRule and rule-driven derivation are Phase 2 concerns.

subject.description: What the insight is about. At least one reference is required; all references are modelReferences to governed artifacts (capability, measure, scenario, ...).

evidence.description: The evidence supporting this insight (CR-AM-08 §6 — mandatory). At least one source artifact is required; an insight without evidence is refused. Every artifact referenced here must also appear in lineage.

interpretation.description: The interpreted statement. Must not assert more than the evidence supports (CR-AM-08 §7 of the as-authored proposal).

confidence.description: How well the evidence supports the statement (CR-AM-08 §5). Confidence never exceeds what evidence coverage justifies; limitations are explicit.

evidence_coverage.description: Percentage of the intended evidence base actually covered.

significance.description: How much the statement matters (CR-AM-08 §5) — independent of confidence. Controlled vocabulary: assessment-models/vocabulary/significance-levels.yaml.

generation.description: How this insight was produced (CR-AM-08 §6). Controlled vocabulary: assessment-models/vocabulary/insight-generation-methods.yaml. The method is audit metadata; the evidence remains the authority — AI-assisted text is interpretation, never fact.

generator.description: Tool, model, or person that produced the interpretation (e.g. 'opendea-insight-engine 0.1.0', 'gpt-x analyst draft').

lineage.description: Full derivation lineage (CR-AM-08 §6): every source artifact, the insight rule + version when rule-generated, and generation timestamp. An insight without complete lineage is not canonical.

sources.description: Mirrors evidence: every cited artifact with id + version.

insight_rule.description: The InsightRule (id + version) that produced this insight, when generation.method = rule. The InsightRule schema itself lands in Phase 2.
